title: feat(ci): add a reusable workflow for consumers
problem: Consumers must copy workflow YAML to use the toolkit in CI.
why: A reusable workflow lowers adoption friction and centralizes best practices.
context: This repository has its own CI; it does not publish a reusable one.
scope: Add a `workflow_call` workflow that runs the toolkit against a caller's repository
guidance: Least privilege by default; never require secrets.
acceptance: Workflow is documented and used by this repository's own CI
tests: A run that consumes the reusable workflow
security: Document every permission; handle fork PRs safely.

title: feat(github): add a SARIF upload workflow
problem: Even when SARIF is produced, nothing uploads it to code scanning.
why: Uploading enables inline annotations and the security tab.
context: SARIF emission is a separate issue; upload is the workflow concern.
scope: Add a workflow that uploads SARIF with `security-events: write`
guidance: Upload only when a results file exists.
acceptance: SARIF appears in code scanning for this repository
security: Fork PRs cannot upload; document the limitation.

title: feat(github): add baseline scanning support
problem: There is no baseline concept, so CI would fail on pre-existing findings.
why: Baselines let teams adopt analysis without blocking on legacy findings.
context: The findings model is a separate issue.
scope: Define a baseline file of finding fingerprints
Support write/compare modes and gate only on new findings
guidance: Fingerprints must be line-independent where appropriate.
tests: Tests for new, existing, and resolved findings
security: Never silently suppress findings; report counts.
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: feat(ci): add a release validation workflow
problem: Releases are not validated before publication.
why: A validation gate prevents shipping broken artifacts.
context: Release artifact building is a separate issue.
scope: Validate the changelog section, version consistency, and that binaries run `--version`
acceptance: Validation runs on a pre-release tag and passes

title: chore(ci): add triage automation for issues and pull requests
problem: Issues and PRs are labeled manually and inconsistently.
why: Consistent labels speed triage and contributor onboarding.
scope: Add lightweight automation to label new issues and request missing information
guidance: Keep permissions minimal and behavior transparent.
security: Least privilege; no secrets in logs.

title: feat(ci): add dependency and license auditing
problem: Dependencies and licenses are not audited in CI.
why: Supply-chain auditing catches advisories and license conflicts early.
context: Dependabot updates are a separate issue.
scope: Add a `cargo-deny` job covering advisories, licenses, bans, and sources
guidance: Keep the allowlist tight and justified.
acceptance: Audit job is green and enforced

title: perf(rpc): measure and document RPC call overhead
problem: RPC overhead (serialization, connection reuse) is unmeasured.
why: Measurement is required before optimization or claims.
context: A local test server is a separate issue.
scope: Benchmark request construction and response parsing against a loopback server
acceptance: Benchmark runs offline and prints results

title: perf(xdr): optimize SCVal decoding for large maps
problem: Large maps and vectors may decode inefficiently.
why: Contract data frequently contains large collections.
context: SCVal collection decoding is a separate issue.
scope: Measure decode time for large collections, then optimize the hot path
performance: This is the optimization; measure it.

title: perf: measure memory usage on large inputs
problem: Memory usage on large inputs is unmeasured.
why: CI containers are memory-constrained; regressions must be visible.
context: Decode benchmarks measure time, not memory.
scope: Sample peak memory for large decode inputs and document limits
guidance: Use platform APIs with a documented fallback.
acceptance: Memory is reported per input size

title: feat(core): add an optional decode cache
problem: Repeated decoding of the same value is recomputed.
why: A bounded cache reduces redundant work in batch workflows.
context: Batch decoding is a separate issue.
scope: Add an opt-in, bounded, content-addressed decode cache
guidance: Off by default; never cache secrets.
acceptance: Cache hits avoid recomputation and are bounded
tests: Unit tests for keys, hits, and eviction
security: Bound memory; do not persist untrusted content.
performance: This is the optimization; measure it.
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: perf: add performance regression tests to CI
problem: Nothing detects a large performance regression before merge.
why: A loose threshold catches accidental quadratic behavior without flaky failures.
context: Benchmarks exist as examples, not gated jobs.
scope: Run the decode and RPC benchmarks in CI and fail only beyond a generous factor vs. a recorded baseline
guidance: Use a wide margin and a single runner OS.
acceptance: CI job configured with a documented threshold
